_what: Bounds of tool:choose-programs-left-running and tool:stop-programs-left-running (do-work/programs-left-running.mjs). `first_process_pid`: the process id of the system's first process, which every program whose parent ended is handed to. `left_behind_fields` and `never_stop_fields`: the fields a person's rule row of each list may hold; any other field is refused, so a misspelt condition never widens what is stopped. `grace_ms`: how long a stop waits for a program to end after asking it to (default, and the most a run may ask), and `look_every_ms` how often it looks. `command_shown`: how many characters of a stopped program's command line its row and notice keep. `notice_kind`: the kind of news the one notice of a sweep that stopped anything is told as.
